target.statement: Monolingual character n-gram TF-IDF + linear SVM trained on 400 labelled chiShona MasakhaNEWS examples reaches macro-F1 0.928 on the official test split (and 0.939 at full data, n95 raw = 200).
target.table_ref: Table 1, MasakhaNEWS row chiShona, column '400 labels m' (0.928)

compute.basis: Paper states the full monolingual model trains in 0.1-6 s on two CPU cores; the cost is downloading MasakhaNEWS, writing the TF-IDF(2-5 char n-grams, 200k features)+LinearSVC(C=0.5) pipeline and running 3 seeds at 400 labels plus the full-data run, all trivial on 8 cores.

blockers: No code link in the PDF (claims a release but no URL), so the pipeline must be re-implemented from the text
Exact stratified subsample seeds are unspecified, so the 0.928 cell will not be matched exactly (expect ~±0.01-0.02)
MasakhaNEWS must be fetched from HuggingFace/GitHub (public but requires knowing the repo)
title: How Many Labels Does a Language Need? Annotation Budgets and Cross-Lingual Pooling for African-Language Text Classification
